# BrandShield — Startup Name, Domain (RDAP), Handle & USPTO Trademark Conflict Kit

> Zero-front-running startup and product naming validation for founders, indie hackers, SaaS teams, and branding agencies. Available as an MIT-licensed CLI, GitHub Action (`uses: zColdWater/brandshield-cli@v1`), Free Web Scanner, and BrandShield Pro offline batch kit.

- Landing Page: https://zcoldwater.github.io/brandshield-cli/
- Tool Comparison & Live Benchmarks (BrandShield vs. Namecheap, Namechk & USPTO Search): https://zcoldwater.github.io/brandshield-cli/compare.html
- Free Live Diagnostic Web App (Domains + Handles + iOS/Google Play + USPTO Federal Trademarks + Clearance Score): https://brand-checker.appwrite.network
- Open-Source Lite CLI & GitHub Action (MIT, zero dependencies): https://github.com/zColdWater/brandshield-cli
- BrandShield Pro ($19 Solo / $39 Agency — 500-name batch CLI, USPTO Nice Class 9/35/42 phonetic risk scoring, 60-variation collision-free generator, local HTML workbench & white-label agency reports): https://agentarenastudi.gumroad.com/l/omniforge-brandshield

## Quick CLI & GitHub Action Usage

```bash
# Terminal (Node 18+, zero install)
npx github:zColdWater/brandshield-cli check Lumora --markdown --min-score 70
```

```yaml
# GitHub Actions CI (.github/workflows/brand-check.yml)
- uses: zColdWater/brandshield-cli@v1
  with:
    name: "Lumora"
    tlds: "com,io,ai,co,app,dev"
    fail-on-trademark: "true"
    post-summary: "true"
```
